title: Haunted Environment
description: Doors, glass, torches, it's like everything you touch is haunted.
body:
# Your world is haunted.
Eventually, you may notice certain things interacting on their own... and strange noises ocurring. 

<details>
<summary>SPOILER for ALL HAUNTS</summary>

- Doors slam open and slam closed
- Buttons and levers get interacted with
- Placed glass breaks (rare)
- Torches break (rare)
- Bells ring on their own

</details>


The mod can be disabled immediately with the following command:
```
/gamerule playersAreHunted false
```
